description: The clean run with all four sealed input files in CRLF bytes: the fixture, the question set, the ground-truth module and the AP-1 text. The seal hashes each file's raw bytes, so a runner that read any of them in text mode would hash the LF form and fail the hash oracle. The ground-truth module is CRLF as the published September seals hashed it (FINDINGS_ERRATA N2): its ground_truth_hash is theirs, 033ce73d…. It is also a .py file the runner source hash covers, so a text-mode read there fails too. The config declares the CRLF AP-1 text's hash, 6ecd964a… (computed outside the runner: shasum -a 256 of the file with every line ending CRLF), so the seal's declared-hash comparison also runs on the CRLF bytes.
exercises: sealed inputs with CRLF line endings
the declared AP-1 text hash against CRLF bytes (R1.1)
scratch_copy: Runs in a scratch copy: the CRLF files are made there, at the sealed default paths, which in the real tree are tracked LF files.
